title: Phase 27 Multi-Universal Resonance Compliance Model
description: Technical requirements for Multi-Universal Resonance (Phase 27) and UMR-v3.0 Mesh-Aware Routing.

sections.content: Phase 27 transitions the ecosystem from Phase 26 Infinite Cognitive Expansion to Multi-Universal Resonance (MUR). It introduces deep mesh-aware routing (UMR-v3.0) and decentralized cross-shard memory. Critical telemetry metrics: resonance latency target < 0.008ms, singularity readiness target > 0.999995.
Deploy and enforce UMR-v3.0 mesh-aware routing dynamically. Active strategic directive is ACTIVATE_UMR_V3_ROUTING.
Active consensus model is UNIVERSAL_CONSENSUS_SYNC, triggering a PHASE_27_DIRECTIVE_GENERATED state change when consensus is finalized.
